name: io.github.Eagle-Logic/ctx
title: ctx — queryable code graph
description: Call graphs, blast radius and API-breakage gates. Every answer reports its own completeness.

packageArguments.description: Run as an MCP server over stdio. The crate installs one binary, `ctx`, whose other subcommands are the same queries on a terminal.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: Directory the server is allowed to read. Every path argument resolves against it and one that escapes it is refused, including via `..` or a symlink. Defaults to the working directory, which is correct for clients that launch the server in the project.
